sentences.en: which sells inflatables here in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 这家公司在旧金山销售充气制品。

sentences.en: That's who you heard from earlier.
sentences.zh: 这就是你刚才听到声音的人。

sentences.en: This is Look Our Way's Nick Kusanovich.
sentences.zh: 这位是 Look Our Way 的尼克·库萨诺维奇。

sentences.en: Yeah, so the technology we license from them has to do with the way the air escapes the inflatable.
sentences.zh: 对，我们从他们那里获得的专利技术，与空气从充气人偶中排出的方式有关。

sentences.en: The air escapes both from throughout the top of the head as well as each one of the arMs.
sentences.zh: 空气不仅从整个头顶排出，也从每一只手臂排出。

sentences.en: So that, you know, after testing, that is what gives it its dynamic motion,
sentences.zh: 这样一来，你知道的，经过测试，这就赋予了它动态感，

sentences.en: kind of the special sauce and why it's so effective.
sentences.zh: 可以说是秘诀所在，也是它如此高效的原因。

sentences.en: Look Our Way has their own name for these things, air dancers.
sentences.zh: Look Our Way 对这些东西有自己的称呼，叫做空气舞者。

sentences.en: And even though they may be licensing pre-existing technology,
sentences.zh: 尽管他们获得的可能是现有技术的授权，

sentences.en: they also invented a whole new use for them.
sentences.zh: 但他们也为这些东西发明了全新用途。

sentences.en: It came to them by way of a farmer in eastern Washington state named Gary Long.
sentences.zh: 这是通过华盛顿州东部一个名叫加里·朗的果农传到他们那里的。

sentences.en: So, little setup.
sentences.zh: 那么，简单铺垫一下。

sentences.en: Gary keeps apple orchards on his property,
sentences.zh: 加里的房产上经营着苹果园，

sentences.en: and he started having a really severe bird problem.
sentences.zh: 他开始遇到非常严重的鸟害问题。

sentences.en: Starlings were eating tons of his apples, like literally 10 tons a year.
sentences.zh: 欧洲椋鸟吃掉了他成吨的苹果，字面意思上每年要吃掉 10 吨。

sentences.en: One season, he lost 20,000 out of 40,000 pounds of Honeycrisp apples,
sentences.zh: 有一季，在遭到鸟类啄食并变得无法销售之后，

sentences.en: after they had been pecked at by birds and rendered unsellable.
sentences.zh: 在他 4 万磅的蜜脆苹果中，有 2 万磅报废了。

sentences.en: And so, Gary Long was looking for ideas.
sentences.zh: 因此，加里·朗一直在寻找解决办法。

sentences.en: I was talking to a person that was selling his products that he grew on his ranch,
sentences.zh: 当时我正在跟一个在果园里卖自己种的水果的人聊天，

sentences.en: running a fruit stand.
sentences.zh: 他在经营一个水果摊。

sentences.en: And so, he wanted to attract people to come to his fruit stand,
sentences.zh: 因此，他想吸引人们来他的水果摊，

sentences.en: so he put one of these air dancers out there that, you know, wiggles and jiggles,
sentences.zh: 于是他摆放了一个这种会扭动摇晃的空气舞者，

sentences.en: and, you know, hoping that people would see that, the dancer,
sentences.zh: 希望能让人们看到这个舞者，

sentences.en: and come over to it and come to his fruit stand.
sentences.zh: 然后走过来，光顾他的水果摊。

sentences.en: Well, it didn't bring any people in of any quantity,
sentences.zh: 嗯，它并没有带来多少人流，

sentences.en: but the thing that he noticed was the birds didn't bother him.
sentences.zh: 但他注意到的一点是，鸟类不来打扰他了。

sentences.en: They weren't coming into his fruit stand and pecking on the fruit.
sentences.zh: 它们不再飞进他的水果摊去啄食水果。

sentences.en: Long story short, Gary bought a few air dancers from Look Our Way,
sentences.zh: 简而言之，加里从 Look Our Way 买了一些空气舞者，

sentences.en: hoping to keep the birds out.
sentences.zh: 希望能把鸟赶走。

sentences.en: The result?
sentences.zh: 结果呢？

sentences.en: As soon as the dancers started dancing, they took off and went to a neighbor.
sentences.zh: 舞者一跳起舞来，鸟儿就腾空而起，飞到邻居家去了。

sentences.en: And so, I said, hey, this looks like it's got possibilities.
sentences.zh: 所以，我说，嘿，这东西看起来很有潜力。

sentences.en: With the air dancers in place,
sentences.zh: 有了这些空气舞者，

sentences.en: Gary was able to get the bird damage down from 20,000 pounds to,
sentences.zh: 加里成功将鸟类造成的损失从 2 万磅降到了——

sentences.en: you ready for this?
sentences.zh: 你准备好听这个了吗？

sentences.en: They got bird damage down to zero.
sentences.zh: 他们将鸟类造成的损失降到了零。

sentences.en: Zero damage.
sentences.zh: 零损失。

sentences.en: Gary Long called up Nick Kusanovich from Look Our Way
sentences.zh: 加里·朗打电话给 Look Our Way 的尼克·库萨诺维奇，

sentences.en: and made some suggestions for how to turn the air dancer into a bona fide scarecrow.
sentences.zh: 并就如何将空气舞者变成名副其实的稻草人提出了一些建议。

sentences.en: They added bits of reflective material to the head,
sentences.zh: 他们在头部添加了一些反光材料，

sentences.en: gave it some angry eyes and some scary teeth,
sentences.zh: 给它配上了愤怒的眼睛和吓人的牙齿，

sentences.en: and transformed the thing from an air dancer to an air ranger.
sentences.zh: 将这个东西从空气舞者变成了空气游侠。

sentences.en: The air ranger section of the Look Our Way website reads,
sentences.zh: Look Our Way 网站上的空气游侠专栏写着：

sentences.en: dynamic, unrepeatable dancing motion keeps birds away time after time.
sentences.zh: 动感十足、变化多端的舞姿一次又一次地将鸟类吓退。

sentences.en: I mentioned the air rangers to Peter Minschel.
sentences.zh: 我把空气游侠的事告诉了彼得·明切尔。

sentences.en: It was the first time he had ever heard of them.
sentences.zh: 这是他第一次听说这东西。

sentences.en: Oh, that's brilliant.
sentences.zh: 哦，这太妙了。

sentences.en: Next time I open up a packet of cornflakes, I'll smile.
sentences.zh: 下次我打开一包玉米片时，我会微微一笑的。

sentences.en: Yeah, so no bitterness on Minschel's part,
sentences.zh: 所以，明切尔并没有表现出任何苦涩，

sentences.en: even though he's not making any money off of these things.
sentences.zh: 尽管他根本没有从这些东西上面赚到钱。

sentences.en: Actually, he loves seeing the two guys around.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他很乐意看到这些充气人偶到处都是。

sentences.en: Can you imagine how I feel when I'm driving down?
sentences.zh: 你能想象当我开车经过时的感受吗？

sentences.en: I don't drive, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实我不会开车。

sentences.en: When a friend is driving me down from a house in town
sentences.zh: 当朋友开车带我从城里的房子出发，

sentences.en: to where we, to our factory building place in Shagaramus,
sentences.zh: 前往我们在沙加拉穆斯的工厂时，

sentences.en: and I see a sort of diminutive version of a tall boy
sentences.zh: 我看到加油站旁有一个缩小版的高个男孩

sentences.en: dancing up a storm by a gas station,
sentences.zh: 正在疯狂地跳舞，

sentences.en: I thought, my God, look at where we reach.
sentences.zh: 我想，天哪，看看我们走到了哪里。

sentences.en: And I'm suddenly aware that they're dancing up over gas stations
sentences.zh: 我突然意识到它们正在全球各地的

sentences.en: all over the planet.
sentences.zh: 加油站上方翩翩起舞。

sentences.en: A part of me can't help but feel delight that,
sentences.zh: 我内心深处忍不住感到一阵喜悦，

sentences.en: oh, goodness, little fella,
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪，小家伙，

sentences.en: look at what you and your island have given to the world.
sentences.zh: 看看你和你的小岛给世界带来了什么。

sentences.en: I don't know how much money Daron Gazit is making off of his Tube Guy patent.
sentences.zh: 我不知道达伦·加济特从他的气模人专利中赚了多少钱。

sentences.en: But whatever it is, you can't really say he didn't earn it.
sentences.zh: 但无论多少，你真的不能说这是他不劳而获。

sentences.en: Sure, maybe it was Peter Minschel's idea,
sentences.zh: 当然，这或许是彼得·明切尔的想法，

sentences.en: but Gazit actually made this thing.
sentences.zh: 但加济特确实把这东西造了出来。

sentences.en: And, as Gazit really wanted me to point out,
sentences.zh: 而且，正如加济特极力向我指出的那样，

sentences.en: he's done a lot of other work with inflatables since then.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，他在充气制品领域还做了许多其他工作。

sentences.en: But I also love knowing about Peter Minschel.
sentences.zh: 但我也很高兴能了解彼得·明切尔的故事。

sentences.en: And that these things are kind of like shopping plaza ambassadors
sentences.zh: 这些东西就像是来自他加勒比海岛屿街头的

sentences.en: from the streets of his Caribbean island.
sentences.zh: 购物广场大使。

sentences.en: Because that is how we dance.
sentences.zh: 因为这就是我们的舞蹈方式。

sentences.en: Limpid and loose to the music of steel drums on his street.
sentences.zh: 伴随着街头钢鼓的音乐，身体柔软而松弛地舞动。

sentences.en: Thousands of us.
sentences.zh: 我们有成千上万的人都在这样跳。

sentences.en: And with that in mind,
sentences.zh: 带着这种心情，

sentences.en: the inflatable figures, the Tube Guys, the Tall Boys,
sentences.zh: 那些充气玩偶、气模人、高个男孩、

sentences.en: the Fly Guys, the Air Dancers, the Air Rangers,
sentences.zh: 飞天人、空气舞者、空气游侠，

sentences.en: I've discovered a whole new joy in them.
sentences.zh: 我在它们身上发现了全新的乐趣。

sentences.en: They probably won't convince me to buy a new car,
sentences.zh: 它们或许不会说服我买一辆新车，

sentences.en: but I will delight in seeing them try.
sentences.zh: 但我会为看着它们努力尝试而感到开心。

sentences.en: And when I look upon them,
sentences.zh: 每当我凝视它们时，

sentences.en: I will know to listen for the distant whisper of a Calypso band.
sentences.zh: 我就会想起远处隐约传来的一阵卡ypso乐队的轻声呢喃。

sentences.zh: 报道来自山姆·迪恩，

sentences.zh: 他此前曾在网络杂志《改革》上

sentences.zh: 编辑是我们的小伙伴萨拉·里奇。

sentences.zh: 常规制作团队包括凯蒂·明格、

sentences.zh: 艾弗里·特拉夫曼以及我，罗曼·马尔斯，

sentences.zh: 我们都参与了制作。

sentences.zh: 特别感谢托德·古利克和巴里·斯坦迪克。

sentences.zh: 我们是 91.7 频率的项目，

sentences.zh: 即地方公共广播电台，

sentences.zh: 位于旧金山的 KALW，

sentences.en: and produced out of the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 节目是在 ArcSign 的办公室里制作的，

sentences.en: an architecture and interiors firm
sentences.zh: 这是一家建筑与室内设计公司，

sentences.en: in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 位于美丽繁华的加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心。

sentences.zh: 你可以在 Facebook 上找到本节目，

sentences.en: who like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 并与其他喜欢本节目的听众交流。

sentences.zh: 所有《99% 隐形》的制作人都在 Twitter 上，

sentences.zh: 所以搜索 99% 隐形，

sentences.en: and you will find us,
sentences.zh: 你就能找到我们，

sentences.en: and you can follow us.
sentences.zh: 并且可以关注我们。

sentences.en: But you're always welcome at our place,
sentences.zh: 不过，我们随时欢迎你光临我们的网站，

sentences.en: at 99PI.org.
sentences.zh: 即 99PI.org。
